fraudRules.name: High Amount Anomaly
fraudRules.description: Flags payments exceeding ₹25,000 or 3.5× higher than customer average ticket size.

fraudRules.name: Velocity Spike Detection
fraudRules.description: Flags customers or IPs attempting >= 3 checkout operations within a 5-minute rolling window.

fraudRules.name: Unrecognized Device Fingerprint
fraudRules.description: Adds risk weight when transaction originates from a browser or device never previously seen.

fraudRules.name: Threat Intelligence / Proxy IP
fraudRules.description: Detects connections originating from commercial VPNs, Tor exit nodes, or flagged IP subnets.

fraudRules.name: Impossible Physical Travel
fraudRules.description: Identifies rapid geographic distance hops that exceed physically plausible velocity.

fraudRules.name: Suspicious / Flagged Merchant
fraudRules.description: Flags payments routed to merchants with prior complaints, low trust score, or suspended status.

fraudRules.name: Deceptive URL / Spoofed VPA
fraudRules.description: Identifies deceptive payment links, typosquatted brand names, or suspicious UPI handles.
